title: Embeddings — Put Meanings on a Map
key_insight: An embedding turns an item into a list of numbers. Similar items are trained to land near one another in that number-space.
body:
## Put Meanings on a Map

A search for “puppy” should find a note about “dogs” even when the exact word never appears. Letter matching alone misses the relationship.

An embedding turns an item into a list of numbers. Similar items are trained to land near one another in that number-space.

Distance is useful only for the purpose the embedding learned. Nearby does not mean identical or true in every sense.
common_mistakes: An embedding is always a readable paragraph.
Vector closeness proves two statements are factually true.
Every similarity metric ranks all vectors identically.
mini_exercise: Draw “Put Meanings on a Map” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Embeddings connect text, images, and users to search, recommendation, retrieval, and neural computation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Put Meanings on a Map,” explain Embeddings without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
